Name: `BTLINUX_HAL`
Description: Use btlinux Bluetooth HAL instead of default controller. Unset to disable.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is deprecated and is being removed in BlissOS 17+.

Name: `BT_BLE_DISABLE`
Description: Disable Bluetooth BLE completely. Unset to re-enable.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is is only available on BlissOS 16+

Name: `BT_BLE_NO_VENDORCAPS`
Description: Disable BLE vendor capabilities. Unset to re-enable.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is is only available on BlissOS 16+

Name: `BT_UART`
Description: Set default Bluetooth UART port. Unset to use auto detection.
Notes: Inherited from Android-x86,  we may not have to use this option again as most of Bluetooth drivers nowadays ultilize HCI.
